summary: Executed backend+frontend regression for new revenue/expense accounting flow on public URL; 6/7 backend tests passed and UI options/data-testid checks passed. One critical backend issue remains in data-flow validation.

critical.issue: Returns is_valid=false after posting current_account_interest + deposit_maturity + deposit_link scenario. Response shows accounting.ledger_trial_mismatches for account 4102 (إيرادات فوائد ودائع): trial_credit=1960.5 vs ledger_credit=158088.5.

action_items: Fix ledger vs trial aggregation mismatch for account 4102 inside validate_accounting_data_flow/calculate_trial_balance_report path.
Re-run /api/admin/data-flow-validation until global is_valid=true for super_admin response.
critical_code_review_comments: Requested behavior is implemented and verified: direct revenue methods force collected + bank debit, deposit_link forces paid + zero deductions + term-deposit debit, and default journal listing excludes source_type=deposit_interest.
validate_accounting_data_flow currently reports ledger_trial_mismatches despite balanced totals; this blocks required is_valid=true gate.
backend/server.py remains very large (>700 lines), raising change-risk for accounting flows and validation logic.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary numeric receipts/expense with ITER69 prefix via API (current_account_interest, deposit_maturity, deposit_link). Cleanup fixture removes revenues, expenses, and journal entries by prefix from MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest result: 6 passed, 1 failed (data-flow-validation only). Passed checks include: revenue/expense forced statuses, required journal debit/credit mapping, period financial statements behavior, journal default source filtering, and ledger all period scoping. UI automation passed for Revenues/Expenses option presence using data-testid. ETA integration is MOCKED and out of scope.
rca of the issue: RCA (observed): /api/admin/data-flow-validation computes is_valid=false due to accounting.ledger_trial_mismatches in social-solidarity. Mismatch item shows account 4102 (إيرادات فوائد ودائع) trial_credit much lower than ledger_credit, indicating inconsistency between trial computation and ledger aggregation window/rules, not endpoint availability failure. Reproduction: login as admin super_admin scope -> call /api/admin/data-flow-validation; observe is_valid=false and mismatch payload. Mitigation: align account filtering and opening/prior movement treatment between validate_accounting_data_flow ledger_totals and calculate_trial_balance_report so both produce identical debit/credit per account for the same period scope.
